# cache

```go
import "github.com/altessa-s/go-optgen/examples/cache"
```

Options of a generic struct, plus `isSet` to tell an explicit option from a default.

## Generation

```go
//go:generate optgen generate --with-isset --source-file $GOFILE
```

## Key types

| Type / function        | Description                                                                           |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `Option[K, V]`         | Generated option type, generic over the cache key and value                           |
| `WithCapacity[K, V]`   | Takes an `int`, so callers pass type arguments: `WithCapacity[string, int](16)`       |
| `WithLoader`, `WithOnEvict` | Infer `K` and `V` from their function argument                                   |
| `isSet`                | Generated by `--with-isset`; `New` raises the default capacity only when unset        |

## Usage

```go
c := cache.New(
	cache.WithCapacity[string, int](2),
	cache.WithOnEvict(func(k string, v int) { log.Println("evicted", k) }),
)
```
